ORDER The petitioner has filed this Writ Petition seeking for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the 1st respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 31.08.2020 and followed by the petitioner's reminder representation on 16.07.2021 and post the petitioner as a Food Safety Officer.
2. The brief facts of the case, as averred by the petitioner, are as follows:-

( i ) The petitioner, after completion of the selection process, was declared and selected to the post of the Health Inspector GR.II on 23.10.2007 and joined the service at Government Primary Health Centre, Kedar, Villupuram.

entities.text: Government Primary Health Centre, Kedar, Villupuram
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Thereafter, the 1st Respondent by invoking power conferred under Section 37 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, deputed the petitioner as Food Safety Officer vide his proceedings in R.No.80849/FSSA/2011/S2 dated 20.09.2011.
The petitioner's name was also included in the list at serial no. 365 and the petitioner has been posted as Food Safety Officer for the area of Thiruvennainallur, Villupuram District.

( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) service without any blemish.
The petitioner was performing his job as a Food Safety Officer without any room for any allegations.

While so, the 1st Respondent by his proceedings in R.No. 11268/2017/S1/FSSA dated 30.05.2019 relieved the petitioner to the parent department of the Public Health and Preventive Medicine and directed the petitioner to handover the charges of the post of Food Safety Officer as per the instruction of the Designated Officer.

Pursuant to the same, the petitioner relieved from the post of Food Safety Officer and joined in the said parent Department at Cuddalore and at present, working as a Health Inspector Grade-1 at Government Primary Heath Center, Sethumadai, Periyapodhu Block, Coimbatore District.
(ii) In the meanwhile, the petitioner was promoted as a Health Inspector Grade 1 in the year 2015.

Further, the petitioner had undergone a special course and training in Food Inspection and Sampling Work, which was conducted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and State Food (Health) Authority.
The petitioner has also undergone a special training for Food Safety Officer, which was conducted by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India at Chennai.

sentences.text: the petitioner also sent a representation to the 1st Respondent on 31.08.2020 and another representation on 16.07.2021.
The same was duly served.
Though there are lot of vacancies in Food Safety Department, the petitioner has not been considered, hence this petition.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has undergone a special course and training in food inspection and sampling work, which was conducted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and State Food (Health) Authority.

Therefore, the petitioner requested the 1st respondent to post him as a food safety officer vide representation dated 31.08.2020 and another representation dated 16.07.2021, the same was not considered, hence this petition.

4. Per contra, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents would submit that the petitioner had been relieved to his parent department of Director of Public Health Department and he was successfully joined in the respective parent department and getting salary till date.

The service rules for the food safety officers had been framed in G.O.Ms.No.438, Health and Family Welfare (M1) Department dated 24.09.2018 in Food Safety Department, as per the service rules, the food safety officers appointment have to be filled up only on direct recruitment, therefore, the process of recruitment for the vacant https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) post of food safety officer had been given to the Medical Services Recruitment Board,
now the recruitment process is almost over to the 131 vacancy posts of food safety officers.

Due to several litigations pending before this court in respect of recruitment, the appointment of newly recruited food safety officers is getting delayed, hence the petitioner cannot be reverted back to food safety department and it is contrary to the act and service rules, thereby pleaded to dismiss the petition.

5. Heard the learned counsel on either side and perused the documents placed on record carefully.
6.
It is to be noted that due to urgent implementation of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, a separate new department had been formed, namely, the Food Safety and Drug Administration Department.

entities.text: Food Safety and Drug Administration Department
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The food inspectors, who were worked in various departments have been drawn to this new department on deputation basis and temporarily appointed as Food Safety Officer in the newly created department.

The petitioner was also appointed as food safety officer on deputation basis, so far, 210 food safety officers have been repatriated to their parent department based on their poor performance and their willingness.

The petitioner was also repatriated to his parent department due to his poor performance by the proceedings in R.No.11268/2017/S1/FSSA dated 30.05.2019 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) and the petitioner joined the duty in his parent department, immediately.
Hence the present Writ Petition is liable to be dismissed.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.
No costs.
